subject.title: Add configurable descriptive agent session labels

question: Should CodexBar adopt and support the new persisted Project, Descriptive, and Descriptive + project session-label modes after the ambiguous process-to-rollout mapping is made safe?
rationale: The P2 mapping defect has a narrow repair path, but whether this new settings surface and SQLite-derived naming behavior belong in the product is a maintainer product decision rather than a mechanical correctness choice.

options.title: Sponsor the feature with a safe correlation guard
options.body: Keep the three label modes, require a unique process-to-rollout association before applying descriptive metadata, and retain Project fallback for ambiguous sessions.

options.title: Keep project-only labels
options.body: Decline the additional settings and metadata-reading surface, preserving the current project-name-only session rows.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the feature with a safe correlation guard
recommendation.body: Keep the three label modes, require a unique process-to-rollout association before applying descriptive metadata, and retain Project fallback for ambiguous sessions.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership and the user-facing settings/menu scope make steipete the best available product-routing candidate.
